facts.name: Spiderwort
facts.notes: Blue flowers open each morning for weeks in early summer over grassy leaves. Cut it back after blooming to keep it tidy.
facts.toxSrc: ASPCA lists inch plant, another Tradescantia, as toxic

companions.why: Combines well with blue spiderworts, blue false indigo and prairie dropseed; try it with catmint and lady's mantle.
